# Atelier Nova

> Atelier Nova is a womenswear store with no pages: the home, the catalog, the
> interactive fitting room and the order flow are all screens generated live by
> the agent BranderUX hosts for it, built at the moment of the question, in the
> brand. The frontend is one component in a thin Next.js shell, open source.

App builders generate pages once, the same app for everyone. A BranderUX
application is generated live: every screen built at the moment of the question,
with the right UX for that user and that action. And it publishes two-sided, a
full site for people, an MCP app for AI agents.

Clicks are questions: clicking a product opens its order panel, right-clicking
anything asks about it, so the interface and the conversation are one loop.
Screens compose from branded elements, nine of them custom to this store, rather
than from code written on the fly. Orders placed here are real records: the
confirmation carries a number, "Track my order" reads it back, and every
conversation and every order is visible to the owner in the BranderUX dashboard.

Your website talks with your clients, by your rules: the AI can never act alone,
visitors confirm every real action with a click, you approve who gets in, your
data stays yours, and every conversation is visible to you.

Built on [BranderUX](https://branderux.com). Build agentic applications, in
minutes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the live store, one BranderUX surface
- [How it works](/about): the architecture, screenshots, FAQ

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BranderUX/atelier-nova): the complete
  shell, a Next.js app whose store surface is one component, the custom element
  sources, and the seed scripts that provision the BranderUX project.
- [BranderUX](https://branderux.com): the platform the store is built and hosted
  on.
- [@brander/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@brander/sdk): the npm package the
  shell uses.
